summary_1line: Bhishma concludes Vishnu’s thousand names and explains their blessings, then begins describing a powerful mantra and the divine beings and sages whose names sanctify recitation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows instructs Yudhishthira while warriors stand silently as he proclaims the thousand names of Vishnu.
A cosmic vision of Vishnu holding conch, mace, and discus while the sun, moon, stars, oceans, and all beings revolve under his power.
Assemblies of sages, Rudras, Adityas, and Vasus appearing across the heavens as their names are invoked in sacred recitation.
